Summary: Creation is the doctrine that God made all things out of nothing, by His Word and for His glory, and pronounced His work good. It grounds human dignity, stewardship of the earth, and worship of God as Maker of heaven and earth.
HistoricalDevelopment: Confessed in the Apostles' and Nicene Creeds in God as Maker of heaven and earth, creation ex nihilo was defended by Irenaeus and Augustine against Gnostic and dualist views in the early centuries.
Interpretations: Christians agree God created all things, while differing on the age of the earth, the interpretation of the days of Genesis 1, and the relationship between biblical teaching and scientific accounts of origins.
RelatedTopics: God; Providence; Humanity; Nature and Creation; Genesis
